plan: docs/plan-research-coverage-2026-09-23.zh.md section 6.2: combine library signals with a simple equal-weight score before any model
inputs: reports/research/signal-cards/library-v1-summary.md (admitted: 12-1 momentum, cluster insider buying; strong avoid-side ICs: idiosyncratic volatility, MAX, 52-week high)
selection_disclosure: components were chosen after library v1, whose cards include 2024-2026; the 2024+ numbers of these composites are therefore not out of sample. The judge is the forward holdout (every month after 2026-09-18) and paper trading.

admission_rule.rank: the library-v1 rank rule (stable_years AND beats_shuffle AND a T1 or T2 top-30 book positive at 20 bp in the full and 2024+ windows AND max |t| >= 2.5)
admission_rule.beats_reference: the T1 top-30 book held 20 sessions at 20 bp has a higher Sharpe AND a shallower max drawdown than mom_12_1's in the full window
admission_rule.strategy_screen: report the T1 20-session book's 2024+ CAGR and max drawdown against G1 (>= 50%/yr, max DD >= -35%); a pass here only earns a preregistered strategy iteration with the exact anchor window and costs, not a promotion

signals.name: comp_c1_mom_quality
signals.rationale: momentum plus the three avoid-side signals, equal weight

signals.name: comp_c2_mom_quality_insider

components.sql: SELECT d.symbol, d.trade_date, CASE WHEN i.buyers_60d >= 2 AND i.open_market_buy_count_60d > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS value FROM read_parquet('data/features/daily_broad/*.parquet') d LEFT JOIN read_parquet('data/features/insider_broad/*.parquet', union_by_name=true) i USING (symbol, trade_date)
